verdict.rationale: Cooley offers document generators and a firm-owned AI company that drafts and updates S-1s on prompt. Those are user-initiated, one-off actions, not automations or recurring schedules that run autonomously in the background. A legal-services platform with AI tooling could plausibly offer background automations, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack documents no such capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
